title: Cant see the red latest reading number when the watch is in 'Always on screen' SW3
body:
When the latest reading is either high or low, and the font colour is changed to red on the Wear OS app to match the phone app styling. 

However, the number is not visible when in 'always on' screen mode. I can see it (barely) on my fossil sport (OLED), but with my SW3 which uses a transflective LCD display the number is pretty much invisible.

Can we add a setting on the Wear OS app to keep the numbers white regardless of high/low status. Toggling  the 'Low color' does not help and I'd rather keep the Dark theme. 
![20200217_120126](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6833057/74652349-cc62a480-517d-11ea-9c3b-19475d3079a3.jpg)
![20200217_120301](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6833057/74652355-cec4fe80-517d-11ea-9a9e-4f8e0de5ee4c.jpg)

comments.body: You can force ambient mode on/off in developer options. choosing a desirable option that looked good on LCD was the right answer.
